{{Image}}
A '''speeder truck''', '''gravtruck''', '''hovertruck''' or '''repulsortruck''', alternatively spelled '''repulsor truck''' or '''hover truck''', was a large type of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used for ground transportation of cargo or personnel (a speeder truck typically had room for ten passengers). Some speeder trucks were also equipped with [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]] for protection.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Santhe Security]] made use of speeder trucks, and a speeder truck played an important role in the [[Battle of Dennaskar]].

The [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]]-owned [[Reclamation Services, Inc.]] purchased a dozen of speeder trucks, removed the passenger space, and opened a cargo space of 60 [[metric ton/Legends|tons]], divided in areas for [[metal/Legends|metals]], [[plastic/Legends|plastics]], and other materials. They were running around the [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] collecting recyclable waste.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
